title: Bayer letters with Third Reich generals about camp trials

tellings.quote: There's even uh letters back and forth between Bayer and some of the generals of the Third Reich.

plain: Letters went back and forth between the German drug company Bayer and generals of the Third Reich about trials carried out in the Nazi camps, according to Brigham Buhler, a health-industry entrepreneur who criticises big pharmaceutical companies. He tells Michels the letters exist but does not say where they are. If true, it would tie a major drug company directly to Nazi experiments on prisoners.
